description: This file defines the EscaperRuntime class in Twig, which manages string escaping strategies for security and output safety in templates. It handles various escaping methods such as HTML, JavaScript, CSS, HTML attributes, and URLs, and allows configuring safe classes and custom escapers.

classes.name: EscaperRuntime
classes.description: Final class implementing runtime extension for string escaping in Twig templates.

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Defines a new escaping strategy with a given callable.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Sets the classes considered safe for auto-escaping, with associated strategies.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Adds a class and its strategies to the safe classes list.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string according to the specified strategy and charset, considering auto-escaping context.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding between different character sets.
